title: Disposition receipt for the Gaussian halo-exponent PR chain (13 open PRs; none retained; one unchecked)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/halo-chain-receipt/`, a source-bound disposition receipt (overlap-receipt card) for the 13 open PRs of the Gaussian halo-exponent chain. It makes no closures and no merge recommendations.

**Claim type:** consolidation receipt. **No new κ.**

## Results

- **Retention.** All 13 PRs (#4437, #4438, #4439, #4442, #4449, #4451, #4452, #4460, #4462, #4468, #4469, #4471, #4472) are single-package additions on base `2a13eb18`. **None is retained on main.** `RECEIPT.json` records each exact head and package blobs.
- **Edges.** The receipt records the dependency edges (for example #4442 ← #4439, #4449; #4462 ← #4452, #4449, #4442) and the coverage edges.
- **Coverage.** Every author PR (jwr404 and mihir-s-05) has at least one independent check by separately written code: #4460, #4468, #4469, #4471, #4472. All checks are by one contributor, though.
- **The one gap.** The open transfer #4462 has no independent check yet.
- **The two routes.** The δ route (#4451, #4452, #4462) implies the ε route's hypothesis with room and gives smaller exponents. The ε results remain valid but are coarser.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/halo-chain-receipt --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/halo-chain-receipt
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/halo-chain-receipt outcome=completed
```

Head: `215956879c9b46d7e62753fc792b04c801a05969`. Base: canonical main `2a13eb18`.
